en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a European town. Multi‑story buildings line both sides of a wide street with trees and a sidewalk; people in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the pavement and a horse‑drawn carriage travels down the road. In the distance, a baroque church with two onion‑domed towers dominates the background. At the top of the card, printed in a serif typeface, is the caption "Bodenbach-Rosawitz."
